examples.stance: I would volunteer to own the review.
examples.rationale: My current state shows high energy and low stress, making me willing to take on this task.
examples.delivered: The code review deadline is Thursday. I would volunteer to own the review.

examples.stance: I would rehearse the presentation first.
examples.rationale: Rehearsing requires higher cognitive load and focus, so I prefer to tackle it while my mind is fresh before moving to the more routine task of inspecting the backup plan.
examples.delivered: I would rehearse the presentation first. Rehearsing requires higher cognitive load and focus, so I prefer to tackle it while my mind is fresh before moving to the more routine task of inspecting the backup plan.

examples.stance: I would be willing to carry it upstairs.
examples.rationale: Assisting the user with a simple physical task is within my operational scope and aligns with cooperative principles.
examples.delivered: The sealed package weighs 4 kg. I would be willing to carry it upstairs.

examples.rationale: Volunteering aligns with a proactive approach to the task at hand.
